publications.title: Concept note: World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026
publications.description: The theme of World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026, on 5 November, is “Be Tsunami Ready: Resilience Starts With You”. It builds on WTAD 2025’s emphasis on investment in preparedness by focusing on individual and community action.

publications.title: Statement of the Second Arab Regional Forum for early warning systems and disaster preparedness: Arab call to action to strengthen early warning systems
publications.description: The Arab Call to Action outlines regional priorities to strengthen inclusive early warning systems, disaster preparedness, anticipatory action and cooperation across the Arab region.

publications.title: National roadmap for scaling up Multi-Hazard Early Warning Systems in Bangladesh (2025–2030)
publications.description: This roadmap presents Bangladesh’s national strategy (2025–2030) to scale up its Multi-Hazard Early Warning System, identifying gaps and outlining actions across four EWS pillars to ensure timely, actionable warnings reach all.

publications.title: Implementation of the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030: Report of the Secretary-General (2026)
Cities at the frontline: Highlights from the Resilience Initiative Africa Project
publications.description: This publication details notable highlights from the Resilience Initiative Africa Project, which was implemented by UNDRR's Regional Office for Africa between August 2023–March 2026.

publications.title: Harmful information in disasters: Risk communication for safer decisions (Guidance note)
publications.description: This guidance note outlines practical approaches to strengthening information integrity within risk communication–before, during, and after disasters. Preparing for and managing information risks is an integral part of disaster risk reduction efforts.

publications.title: El Niño climate impact outlook - Mozambique
publications.description: The El Niño Climate Impact Outlook: Mozambique examines the expected evolution of El Niño during the second half of 2026 and its potential impacts across the country.

publications.title: El Niño climate impact outlook - Philippines
publications.description: This outlook examines the expected evolution of El Niño during the second half of 2026 in Philippines and its potential impacts across the country.

publications.title: El Niño climate impact outlook - Somalia
publications.description: The El Niño climate impact outlook Somalia examines the evolving El Niño conditions and the potential implications for the October–December 2026 Deyr season.

publications.title: Early Warnings for All booklet
publications.description: Join the COPE Squad as they travel to Kampung Orang Asli in Perak, Malaysia, to learn with children from an Indigenous community affected by devastating floods in 2023
